mapper.select: SELECT ID, NodeID, SensorCode, SensorName, GroupID, SensorRemark, SensorUnit, LimitType, LimitNotice, LimitAttention, LimitWarning, LimitValueLaw, LimitNoticeBegin, LimitNoticeEnd, LimitAttentionBegin, LimitAttentionEnd, imitWarningBegin, LimitWarningEnd, LimitValueLawBegin, LimitValueLawEnd FROM Sensor WHERE ID = #{sensorID}

SELECT ID, NodeID, SensorCode, SensorName, GroupID, SensorRemark, SensorUnit, LimitType, LimitNotice, LimitAttention, LimitWarning, LimitValueLaw, LimitNoticeBegin, LimitNoticeEnd, LimitAttentionBegin, LimitAttentionEnd, imitWarningBegin, LimitWarningEnd, LimitValueLawBegin, LimitValueLawEnd FROM Sensor WHERE NodeID = #{nodeID}
SELECT NodeDataTable FROM Sensor INNER JOIN NetNode ON NodeID = NetNode.ID WHERE Sensor.ID = #{sensorID}
SELECT NodeLastTable FROM Sensor INNER JOIN NetNode ON NodeID = NetNode.ID WHERE Sensor.ID = #{sensorID}
SELECT NodeDataTable FROM NetNode WHERE ID = #{nodeID}
SELECT NodeLastTable FROM NetNode WHERE ID = #{nodeID}

SELECT ss.ID as id, tbl.NetNodeID as nodeID, tbl.SensorCode as SensorCode, tbl.SensorValue as SensorValue, tbl.ExtraValue as ExtraValue, tbl.TimeStamp as TimeStamp FROM ${tableName} AS tbl INNER JOIN Sensor as ss on ss.NodeID = tbl.NetNodeID AND ss.SensorCode = tbl.SensorCode

SELECT ss.ID as sensorID, tbl.NetNodeID as nodeID, tbl.SensorCode as SensorCode, tbl.SensorValue as SensorValue, tbl.ExtraValue as ExtraValue, tbl.TimeStamp as TimeStamp FROM ${tableName} AS tbl INNER JOIN Sensor as ss on ss.NodeID = tbl.NetNodeID AND ss.SensorCode = tbl.SensorCode WHERE ss.ID = #{sensorID} ORDER BY TimeStamp DESC limit 1
SELECT NetNodeID as nodeID, SensorCode, SensorValue, ExtraValue, TimeStamp FROM ${tableName} WHERE NetNodeID = #{nodeID} AND SensorCode = #{sensorCode} ORDER BY TimeStamp DESC limit 1

SELECT ss.ID as sensorID, tbl.NetNodeID as nodeID, tbl.SensorCode as SensorCode, tbl.SensorValue as SensorValue, tbl.ExtraValue as ExtraValue, tbl.TimeStamp as TimeStamp FROM ${tableName} AS tbl INNER JOIN Sensor as ss on ss.NodeID = tbl.NetNodeID AND ss.SensorCode = tbl.SensorCode WHERE ss.ID = #{sensorID} AND TimeStamp BETWEEN #{timeFrom} AND #{timeTo} ORDER BY ss.ID
LIMIT #{maxCount}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (NetNodeID, SensorCode, SensorValue, ExtraValue, TimeStamp) VALUES (#{nodeID}, #{sensorCode}, #{sensorValue}, #{extraValue}, #{timeStampString})
INSERT INTO ${tableName} (NetNodeID, SensorCode, SensorValue, ExtraValue, TimeStamp) VALUES (#{nodeID}, #{sensorCode}, #{sensorValue}, #{extraValue}, #{timeStampString})
mapper.select:
SELECT NetNodeID as ID, NetNodeID as nodeID, SensorCode, max(SensorValue) as SensorValue, ExtraValue, TimeStamp, CASE
WHEN TimeStamp BETWEEN CAST('${timeItem}' AS DATETIME)
AND CAST('${timeItem}' AS DATETIME) THEN (FLOOR( ${index} / 2 ) + 1)
ELSE -1 END as TimeIdx FROM ${tableName} WHERE NetNodeID = #{nodeID} AND SensorCode IN
${item}
AND TimeStamp BETWEEN CAST('${timeFrom}' AS DATETIME) AND CAST('${timeTo}' AS DATETIME) GROUP BY SensorCode, TimeIdx ORDER BY SensorCode, TimeIdx
